title: How to Hear God’s Voice Every Day
titleZh: 每天如何聆聽神的聲音
summaryZh: 懼怕人是因為失去了對神的注視，唯有敬畏神才是對付懼怕人的根本解藥。
lines: All right, now let's get back to the verse I really want: Isaiah 51.
好，現在我們回到我真正想講的經文：以賽亞書五十一章。
Go to Isaiah 51, and we'll spend our remaining time in this kind of an abstract portion of Scripture.
翻到以賽亞書五十一章，我們要把剩下的時間花在這段有點抽象的經文上。
There's a little bit of difference again between... I have New King James and New American Standard,
這裡又有一點翻譯上的差異……我有新欽定版和新美國標準版，
and I've tried to study both to make sure that what I'm going to emphasize is accurate,
我試著研讀這兩個版本，好確保我要強調的內容是準確的，
and I do believe with all of my heart that it is.
而且我全心相信它是準確的。
All right, so I'm going to read out of the New King James, and then I'll make reference to a couple words.
好，所以我要讀新欽定版，然後我會提到幾個詞。
好，以賽亞書五十一章十二節：
"I, even I, am He who comforts you. Who are you that you should be afraid?"
「惟有我，是安慰你們的。你是誰，竟會害怕？」
The Lord shows up and says, "I, even I, am the Lord who comforts you. Who do you think you are, being afraid?"
主顯現並說：「惟有我，是安慰你的主。你以為你是誰，竟敢害怕？」
Now, when I'm fearful, I want Papa God to come and cuddle me, massage my shoulders, soothe me,
當我感到害怕時，我想要天父來擁抱我、按摩我的肩膀、安撫我，
tell me it's going to be okay, "I'm going to go before you, I'm going to drive out the enemy forces, I'm going to protect you."
告訴我一切都會沒事的：「我會走在你的前面，我會趕出敵軍，我會保護你。」
But in this particular case, He chose not to do that.
但在這個特定的情況下，祂選擇不這麼做。
He said, "I, even I, am the one who comforts you. Who do you think you are, being afraid?"
祂說：「惟有我，是安慰你的。你以為你是誰，竟敢害怕？」
What right do you have to be afraid?
That may not be the way you want to hear it, but sometimes it's the way He delivers it.
這也許不是你想聽到的方式，但有時候祂就是這樣表達的。
This is perhaps an offensive thought, but I want you to think it through.
這或許是個會冒犯人的想法，但我希望你仔細思考一下。
If I become inward, if I become internal, all wrapped up and, "Oh no, this is going on, this is going on in my life, this is happening,"
如果我變得退縮，變得內向，完全陷入自我中心，想著：「喔不，這件事發生了，我的生活中發生這個，正在發生那個，」
I am going to end up in fear.
Fear sometimes is the expression of selfishness, because it has lost a glimpse of the one who spread out the heavens.
恐懼有時是自私的表現，因為它失去了對那位鋪張諸天之神的注視。
He reveals Himself in this passage as the one who gives comfort.
祂在這段經文中啟示自己是賜下安慰的那一位。
In other words, I have to lose sight of Him to become fearful.
換句話說，我必須失去對祂的注視才會變得恐懼。
Here, let's read it again, verse 12:
來，我們再讀一次，第十二節：
"I, even I, am He who comforts you.
Who are you that you should be afraid of a man who will die, of the son of man who will be made like grass?"
你是誰，竟怕那必死的人？怕那要變如草的世人？」
What is He dealing with here? He's confronting the fear of man.
祂在這裡處理的是什麼？祂在對付對人的懼怕。
I have people come to me, if I ever talk about this subject,
如果我談到這個主題，就會有人來找我，
people will line up and ask me to pray for them to be freed from the fear of man, which I do.
人們會排隊請我為他們禱告，好讓他們從對人的懼怕中得釋放，我也會這麼做。
But there is one basic cure for the fear of man: it's called the fear of God.
但要治癒對人的懼怕，有一個根本的解藥：這就叫做敬畏神。
And forgive me for repeating, but people will say, "Well, there's no fear in love.
原諒我再重複一次，但人們會說：「愛裡沒有懼怕。
How can I love God and fear Him?"
我怎麼能既愛神又敬畏祂呢？」
You must not be married. That's all I've got to say about that.
那你一定還沒結婚。關於這點我只能說這麼多。
Whoever made up that one is obviously single.
說出那句話的人顯然是單身。
That's all I got to say, and all the married men said, "Amen."
我言盡於此，然後所有已婚的男人都說：「阿們。」
All right, verse 12, let's do it again.
好，第十二節，我們再來一次。
She told me to stand in that line, there it is.
她叫我去排那個隊，就在那裡。
I didn't even realize my jokes were prophetic this morning!
我今早甚至沒意識到我的笑話是先知性的！
I didn't even realize, but they are.
我完全沒意識到，但它們確實是。
See verse 12: "I, even I, am He who comforts you.
看第十二節：「惟有我，是安慰你們的。
Who are you that you should be afraid of a man who will die, of the son of man who will be made like grass?
你是誰，竟怕那必死的人？怕那要變如草的世人？
And you forget the Lord your Maker, who stretched out the heavens, who laid the foundations of the earth;
卻忘記鋪張諸天、立定地基、創造你的耶和華？
you have feared continually every day because of the fury of the oppressor, when he has prepared to destroy.
因欺壓者圖謀毀滅要發的暴怒，你每天不斷地害怕，
And where is the fury of the oppressor?"
其實那欺壓者的暴怒在哪裡呢？」
Do you get a feel for what He's saying here?
你能體會祂在這裡說什麼嗎？
You're afraid of whoever—put someone in the blank—you're afraid of them.
你害怕某個人——在空格裡填上某個人——你害怕他們。
You had to exchange a fear of them... you replaced the fear of God with fearing a person.
你必須把對他們的恐懼交換掉……你用對人的懼怕取代了對神的敬畏。
Repent! I mean, that really is it. It's just repent, confess the sin of the fear of man.
悔改！我的意思是，真的就是這樣。只要悔改，承認懼怕人這項罪。
I'm not trying to do shame, guilt, you know, I'm not interested in that.
我不是要讓你感到羞愧、內疚，你知道的，我對那沒興趣。
But I am interested in people being free from the fear of man.
但我非常有興趣讓人們從對人的懼怕中得釋放。
And turning from the fear of man to the fear of God is just a short step.
而從懼怕人轉向敬畏神，只是很短的一步。
That's just a short step; you turn from one to the other.
這只是短短的一步；你從其中一個轉向另一個。
